title: Scene Runtime Uses Three Fixture Only
description: Remove compose authoring-plane coordinate conversion from the Three/R3F scene runtime. Scene consumes elements.scene.fixture/v1 with origin+orientation already in standard Three.js Y-up world space. Keep authoring→fixture conversion only in the nakagin bake path (authoringToThreeFixture + composeDesignPlane ingestion). Delete coordsPlane; move embedded tests off react/index.
summary: Scene R3F runtime no longer imports compose plane helpers or exports planeBasisToThreeJs. Authoring→Three fixture math lives only in authoringToThreeFixture (used by nakaginSceneBake); composeDesignPlane remains bake-side ingestion. Removed coordsPlane.ts; Vitest now runs embedded tests in authoringToThreeFixture.ts and composeDesignPlane.ts. Re-ran bun ./script.ts test (Vitest + Playwright) and bake nakagin — fixture unchanged.
